title: Grammatical Error Correction for Low-Resource Languages: The Case of Zarma
abstract: arXiv:2410.15539v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Grammatical error correction (GEC) aims to improve text quality and readability. Previous work on the task focused primarily on high-resource languages, while low-resource languages lack robust tools. To address this shortcoming, we present a study on GEC for Zarma, a language spoken by over five million people in West Africa. We compare three approaches: rule-based methods, machine translation (MT) models, and large language models (LLMs). We evaluated GEC models using a dataset of more than 250,000 examples, including synthetic and human-annotated data. Our results showed that the MT-based approach using M2M100 outperforms others, with a detection rate of 95.82% and a suggestion accuracy of 78.90% in automatic evaluations (AE) and an average score of 3.0 out of 5.0 in manual evaluation (ME) from native speakers for grammar and logical corrections. The rule-based method was effective for spelling errors but failed on complex context

translated_title: 低资源语言的语法错误纠正：以哲尔马语为例
translated_abstract: 语法错误纠正（GEC）旨在提升文本的质量与可读性。以往针对该任务的研究主要集中在高资源语言上，而低资源语言缺乏强大的工具。为弥补这一不足，我们针对哲尔马语开展了一项语法错误纠正研究，这是一种在西非有超过五百万人使用的语言。我们比较了三种方法：基于规则的方法、机器翻译（MT）模型以及大语言模型（LLM）。我们使用一个包含超过25万个样本的数据集（包括合成数据和人工标注数据）对GEC模型进行了评估。结果表明，基于M2M100的机器翻译方法优于其他方法，在自动评估（AE）中检测率达95.82%、建议准确率达78.90%；在由母语者进行的人工评估（ME）中，语法和逻辑纠错的平均得分为3.0分（满分5.0分）。基于规则的方法对拼写错误有效，但在复杂语境下则难以奏效。
tldr: 本文首次针对低资源语言哲尔马语开展语法错误纠正研究，比较了基于规则、机器翻译和大语言模型三种方法，发现基于M2M100的机器翻译方法表现最佳，并构建了超过25万样本的数据集用于评估。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a study on grammatical error correction for the low-resource language Zarma, comparing rule-based, machine translation, and LLM approaches, and shows that the M2M100-based MT approach performs best using a dataset of over 250,000 examples.
